mapper.sql: t.contractor_id, t.name, t.uscc, t.ctype, t.legal_person, t.legal_phone, t.safety_person, t.safety_phone, t.register_address, t.register_capital, t.deposit, t.login_account, case when t.login_pwd is null or t.login_pwd = '' then null else '******' end as login_pwd, t.phone, t.id_card, t.post_name, t.role_name, t.coop_status, t.approve_status, t.reject_reason, t.creator, t.open_status, (select d.item_name from cbs.t_dict d where d.item_id = t.ctype) as ctype_name
mapper.select: select from cbs.t_contractor t where t.contractor_id = #{id}
select contractor_id, name from cbs.t_contractor where open_status = true and approve_status = 1 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_contractor (contractor_id, name, uscc, ctype, legal_person, legal_phone, safety_person, safety_phone, register_address, register_capital, deposit, login_account, phone, id_card, post_name, role_name, coop_status, approve_status, creator, open_status) values (#{c.contractor_id}, #{c.name}, #{c.uscc}, #{c.ctype}, #{c.legal_person}, #{c.legal_phone}, #{c.safety_person}, #{c.safety_phone}, #{c.register_address}, #{c.register_capital}, #{c.deposit}, #{c.login_account}, #{c.phone}, #{c.id_card}, #{c.post_name}, #{c.role_name}, #{c.coop_status}, #{c.approve_status}, #{c.creator}, #{c.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_contractor set open_status = false where contractor_id = #{id}
update cbs.t_contractor set open_status = true where contractor_id = #{id}
